details.title: AI Engineer
details.short_description: Brightwater Systems builds software that helps regional insurers process claims faster. As an AI Engineer on the Applied AI team, you will build and ship features that use large language models on top of our claims data.

good.scope_expectation: You will own well-defined components end to end, such as a retrieval pipeline or an evaluation harness.
good.complexity_criteria: Designing evaluation sets and automated checks for answer correctness and groundedness, along with improving quality and cost through caching, tuning, and request routing.

good_quotes.scope_expectation: You will own well-defined components end to end, such as a retrieval pipeline or an evaluation harness, working closely with a senior engineer on design and with product and data partners on what to build.
good_quotes.complexity_criteria: Improve quality and cost: caching, prompt and retrieval tuning, and routing simple requests to smaller models.
good_quotes.expected_reach: Partner with product, design and the claims operations team to turn adjuster feedback into model and product improvements.
